subject: ROOM #5
text: ROOM #5 has 5 floating jellyfish and a lone frog in the middle, which can be killed or jumped around to reach ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room has 5 floating jellyfish and a lone frog in the middle. 
    You can kill them or just skillfully jump around them to ROOM #6.

subject: ROOM #6
text: In ROOM #6 are two swans, three jellyfish, and a hippopotamus, none of which have to be killed to reach ROOM #7 to the North.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    In this room are two swans and three jellyfish. There is also a 
    hippopotamus but you don't have to kill any of them to get to the 
    ROOM #7 to the North.

subject: ROOM #7
text: ROOM #7 leads back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    Exit back to overworld.

subject: Monkey Savannah
text: An ASCII map displays the layout and paths for MONKEY MAZE PART #3.

evidence.quote:
- - - M O N K E Y  M A Z E  P A R T # 3 - - -


             LEGEND FOR MONKEY MAZE PART #3
                       O = Starting Point
                       X = Exit

subject: Monkey Maze Part #3
text: To navigate Monkey Maze Part #3, move down and to the left, up the West side of the map, and then back East along the Northern part of the map to exit out on the Northern edge.

evidence.quote:
Move down and to the left and then up
    the West side of the map. Then go back East along the Northern part
    of the map. Eventually you will make it out on the Northern edge

subject: psychic shock wave
text: At a small mountain range, the monkey shows Mike how to do a psychic shock wave before Mike is teleported back to the Pyramid and Sphinx.

evidence.quote:
make your way to a small mountain range where that monkey 
    (Merlin?!?) will show you how to do a psychic shock wave. Then you 
    will be teleported back to the Pyramid and Sphinx.

subject: Pyramid
text: An ASCII map outlines the 26 rooms and layout of the Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
=======
    PYRAMID
    =======

    LEGEND FOR PYRAMID
    1 = Starting Point for Pyramid
    25 = BOSS: PHAROAH
    26 = Leads to Overworld

subject: ROOM #1
text: In ROOM #1, jumping on the middle tile in the group of tiles to the left makes two hearts appear.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    If you are low on hearts you can jump on the middle tile in the 
    group of tiles to the left and two hearts will appear.

subject: ROOM #1
text: Head North from ROOM #1 to reach ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
In either 
    case, head North to ROOM #2.

subject: force field
text: The force field in ROOM #2 requires the Psychic Shockwave to destroy before continuing North to ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    This force field requires the Psychic Shockwave to destroy. Dispose 
    of the field and continue to the North to ROOM #3.

subject: ROOM #3
text: ROOM #3 contains three ladybugs that must be disposed of to open the door West to ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are three ladybugs in here. Dispose of the them and the door 
    will open to the West to ROOM #4.

subject: ROOM #4
text: In ROOM #4, stairs in the upper left corner lead to ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There are two asps in here. Dispose of the them if you want to or 
    just take the stairs in the upper left corner of the room to 
    ROOM #5.

subject: ROOM #5
text: In ROOM #5, stop after passing the first flame and jump over that part of the floor, or you will fall back to the floor below with the asps.

evidence.quote:
Once you
    pass this first flame STOP. If you proceed any farther you will fall 
    back to the floor below with the asps. Instead jump over this part 
    of the floor.

subject: ROOM #5
text: In ROOM #5, jump on one of the tiles in the top group to reveal a question mark at the bottom of the room, which opens the East door to ROOM #6 when grabbed.

evidence.quote:
Now go up to the top group of tiles and jump on one of the 
    tiles to reveal the question mark at the bottom of the room. Jump 
    over the spikes and flames to get to the bottom of the room and once 
    you grab the question mark the door to the East will open.

subject: ROOM #5
text: There are two hearts located on the north side of ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
There are 
    two hearts on the north side of the room, get them if you'd like and 
    then go East to ROOM #6.

subject: ROOM #7
text: In ROOM #7, defeating the mummy and mini-mummy and hopping on a tile reveals a question mark that opens the chest to reveal a medicine container.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    When you first enter this room you will see a mummy and mini-mummy. 
    Take both of them out and then hop on one of the tiles to reveal the 
    question mark. Get this mark to open the chest and reveal a medicine
    container.

subject: ROOM #7
text: In ROOM #7, jump to the right side of the room to take the door South to ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
Get the medicine and jump to the right side of this room. There are 
    two more mini mummies you can choose to defeat before taking the 
    door to the South to ROOM #8.

subject: Aman-Ra guardian
text: Defeating the one Aman-Ra guardian in ROOM #8 opens the door East to ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    Inside this room is one Aman-Ra guardian. Just take your time and 
    defeat him to open the door and head East to ROOM #9.

subject: ROOM #9
text: In ROOM #9, fall through the false floors in the middle of the circular pattern of tiles to get to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    All that is in this room are a circular pattern of tiles. In the 
    middle of these tiles are false floors which you need to fall 
    through to get to ROOM #10.

subject: ROOM #10
text: Press the control pad to the left while falling into ROOM #10, or you will land on another false floor and plunge down to ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    As you fall into this room press your control pad to the left. If 
    you don't you will land on another false floor and plunge down to 
    ROOM #11.

subject: ROOM #10
text: In ROOM #10, a pair of two hearts is located in the bottom left corner of the room.

evidence.quote:
When you do manage to reach ROOM #10 without falling 
    through you will see a pair of two hearts in the bottom left corner 
    of the room.

subject: ROOM #10
text: From ROOM #10, head East while avoiding the metal ball moving in a circular pattern to reach ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10: ... Get them if you need them otherwise head to the East 
    (avoiding the metal ball that is moving in a circular pattern) into 
    ROOM #12.

subject: ROOM #11
text: ROOM #11 contains four skeletons, with stairs in the upper right corner leading to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    There is nothing in this room except four skeletons. Dispose of the 
    them if you want to or just take the stairs in the upper right 
    corner of the room to ROOM #10.

subject: ROOM #12
text: Defeating both the pyramid guardian and the asp on the directional conveyor belt in ROOM #12 opens the door East to ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    Inside this room a directional conveyor belt with a pyramid 
    guardian and an asp. You can use the conveyor belt if you need to 
    but just focus on defeating both enemies to open the door and head 
    East to ROOM #13.

subject: ROOM #13
text: In ROOM #13, jump up the columns on the right and jump left to the column with tiles, then jump on a tile to reveal a question mark that opens the wall East to ROOM #14.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    There are four skeletons and one metal ball. Avoid them and head to 
    the right side of the room and jump up on the columns and head back 
    left jumping until you come to the column with the tiles. Jump on 
    one of these tiles to make the question mark appear. Jump down and 
    grab this mark which will open the wall to the East to ROOM #14.

subject: ROOM #14
text: In ROOM #14, defeating the mummy near Mike, the ladybugs in the middle, and the remaining mummy opens the door North to ROOM #15.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14:
    Immediately upon entering this room dispose of the mummy nearby 
    Mike. Then jump over the spikes and defeat the ladybugs in the 
    middle of the room. Take out the remaining mummy and the door to 
    the North will open to ROOM #15.

subject: ROOM #14
text: ROOM #14 contains a life sign.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14: ... There is also a life sign in here 
    if you want to try your luck.

subject: ROOM #15
text: Defeating the two Aman-Ra guardians in ROOM #15 opens the door North to ROOM #16.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #15:
    Inside this room are two Aman-Ra guardians. Just take your time and 
    defeat them to open the door North to ROOM #16.

subject: spiders
text: In ROOM #16, ride the middle conveyor belt around to defeat each of the spiders on the ledges to open the door North to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    When you enter this room you will see spikes along the outside of 
    the room with a conveyor in the middle. You must go around on this 
    conveyor and defeat each of the spiders on the ledges to open the 
    door North to ROOM #17.

subject: ROOM #17
text: In ROOM #17, defeating the three ladybugs opens the door West to ROOM #18, and jumping on a middle tile reveals two hearts.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17:
    Inside this room are three ladybugs. After you defeat them to open 
    the door West to ROOM #18 you can jump on a tile in the middle to 
    reveal two hearts if you need them.

subject: ROOM #18
text: ROOM #18 contains two mini mummies and two pyramid guardians whose defeat opens the door North to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #18:
    This room contains two mini mummies and two pyramid guardians. 
    Defeat them to open the door North to ROOM #19.

subject: ROOM #19
text: In ROOM #19, jumping on the tail tile of the snake-like tile pattern reveals a question mark that opens the door East to ROOM #20.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19:
    No enemies here, just a pattern of tiles that resembles a snake. 
    Jump on the tail tile to reveal the question mark. Grabbing this 
    mark opens the door East to ROOM #20.

subject: ROOM #20
text: Defeating the two mummies in ROOM #20 opens the door East to ROOM #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20:
    This room contains two mummies. Defeat them to open the door East 
    to ROOM #21.

subject: ROOM #21
text: In ROOM #21, jumping on a tile at the top of the room reveals medicine, and defeating the one Aman-Ra guardian opens the door South to ROOM #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21:
    There is one Aman-Ra guardian in here. Defeat him to open the door 
    South to ROOM #22. There is a tile at the top of the room you can 
    jump on to make a medicine appear so don't forget that.

subject: ROOM #22
text: In ROOM #22, activating the tile and grabbing the question mark reveals a flute from inside the chest.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22:
    There are four mini mummies in here and a tile. Activate the tile 
    and get the question mark to reveal a flute from inside the chest. 
    Grab the flute

subject: ROOM #22
text: Defeating the four mini mummies in ROOM #22 opens a wall to the West leading back to ROOM #17.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22: ... Grab the flute and defeat the mini mummies to open a wall to the 
    West taking you back to ROOM #17.

subject: flute
text: In ROOM #19, playing the flute makes three asps appear, and defeating all three opens a wall to the North leading into ROOM #23.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19 (Revisited):
    Now that you have the flute use a flute to make three asps appear. 
    Defeat all three and a wall to the North will open up allowing you 
    to enter ROOM #23.

subject: ROOM #23
text: ROOM #23 has no enemies and leads North to ROOM #24.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #23:
    Nothing here so just take the door North to ROOM #24.

subject: ROOM #24
text: ROOM #24 has two hearts and a medicine in the left corner across the floating tiles.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24:
    There is a mummy and mini mummy here with another floating tile out 
    in the middle to jump to. Defeat the mummies and jump across the 
    tiles to the left until you make it to the other side. There are 
    two hearts here is you want them and also another medicine over on 
    the left corner of the room.

subject: ROOM #24
text: From ROOM #24, take the path to the North to reach ROOM #25.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24: ... There are two more mummies and a mini 
    mummy on the left which you can defeat or just simply take the path 
    to the North and ROOM #25.

subject: PHAROAH
text: The PHAROAH boss floats in the top part of the room shooting a spray of 5 bullets and occasional skeleton-face shots, moving faster and turning red as damaged.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #25: BOSS: PHAROAH

    You enter a room that has the bottom half covered in conveyors that 
    force you back to the bottom wall. The room is separated in half by 
    a guard rail. The top part of the room is where the boss float 
    around. This mask mostly shoots a spray of 5 bullets which are 
    usually pretty easy to avoid. Occasionally the mask will reveal a 
    skeleton face and shoot a more powerful shot so avoid those. As you 
    damage the mask more and more it will move faster and eventually 
    turn red.

subject: ROOM #25
text: Defeating PHAROAH opens a door to the East leading to ROOM #26.

evidence.quote:
Once you have defeated him a door will open to your East
    allowing you on to ROOM #26.

subject: ROOM #26
text: In ROOM #26, take the exit to the North.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #26:
    Exit room. Just take the exit to the North.

subject: Tetrad
text: Following the long narrow tunnel North inside the pyramid leads to a room where Mike obtains another Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Back inside of the pyramid Mike sees a long narrow tunnel to his 
    North. Follow this until you enter a room with another Tetrad. 
    After Mike obtains his latest Tetrad he reads again the words: 
    PAA PAA PAA OOM PAPA MOW MOW.

subject: Sherlock Holmes
text: In Scotland Yard, Sherlock Holmes tells Mike that Zoda-X will be at the museum tonight and to meet him there at midnight.

evidence.quote:
This looks 
    to be Sherlock Holmes' stomping ground. In fact once you walk 
    around a bit you will eventually bump into him. He tells you that a 
    fella named Zoda-X will be at the museum tonight and to meet him 
    there at midnight.

subject: police officer
text: Talking to a police officer in London results in Mike being put in jail.

evidence.quote:
continue along until you find one of London's finest police 
    officers. Talk to him and he will put you in jail

subject: jail
text: Examining the East wall inside the jail reveals an escape route leading back outside.

evidence.quote:
Turns out if you look along the 
    East wall you will find an escape. Take this to get back outside.

subject: Scotland Yard
text: Outside the jail, head North and West between two buildings, pass the sleep walker, and continue North to reach the museum.

evidence.quote:
Now that you are outside head North and the West until you come 
    between two building. Pass through them and say hello to the sleep 
    walker as you pass him in the night. Continue along North until 
    you find the museum and Holmes waiting for you.

subject: BIG HEART
text: On the streets of London, head left and descend the open manhole to obtain a BIG HEART.

evidence.quote:
When you see Mike 
    again on the streets of London have him head left to the open 
    manhole. There is a BIG HEART below that Mike could really use.

subject: sewer dungeon
text: After exiting the first manhole, enter the other manhole to the South to begin the sewer dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Once you have the BIG HEART go back up the manhole and then look 
    for the other manhole South of there. Take this down to start the 
    sewer dungeon.
